trigger: Updating an existing short ro.appcompat_override.* value with an active override tree
cause: The inherited Update path looks for the prefixed name inside the shadow tree, where the name is unprefixed, then dereferences the absent entry.
fix: Recreate prefixed properties through the existing delete/add path, which translates their names into the shadow tree. Ordinary updates retain the maintained v31 semantics.
method: Actual CLI binaries and platform getprop readers; copied property areas bind-mounted in a private namespace. The original namespace was checked after each run.
